subject: AS A RESPONSE MEASURE TO THE DECISION OF THE AVIATION AUTHORITIES
text:
U1539/26 NOTAMR U1047/26 Q) UUWV/QOAXX/IV/BO/A/000/999/5535N03617E999 A) UUUU  PART 1 OF 2  B) 2611150500  C) 2702152359 EST  E) AS A RESPONSE MEASURE TO THE DECISION OF THE AVIATION AUTHORITIES
OF AUSTRIA, STIPULATING THAT ALL RUSSIAN REGISTERED ACFT AND
ACFT OWNED, CHARTERED OR OPERATED BY NATURAL OR LEGAL PERSONS
OF THE RUSSIAN FEDERATION OR BY OPERATORS HOLDING AIR OPERATOR
CERTIFICATE (AOC) ISSUED BY THE RUSSIAN FEDERATION AUTHORITIES ARE
PROHIBITED FROM ENTERING, EXITING OR OVERFLYING AUSTRIAN AIRSPACE
EXCEPT FOR HUMANITARIAN, SAR AND LEASED ACFT ONE-WAY RETURN FLIGHTS
WITH THE PERMISSION OF THE APPROPRIATE AUSTRIAN AUTHORITIES AND
CASES OF EMERGENCY LANDING OR EMERGENCY OVERFLIGHT, SUP 011/26,
THE AVIATION AUTHORITIES OF THE RUSSIAN FEDERATION HEREBY INFORM OF
THE PROHIBITION OF FLIGHT OPERATIONS WI AIRSPACE OF THE RUSSIAN
FEDERATION TO ALL AIRCRAFT REGISTERED IN THE REPUBLIC OF AUSTRIA
AND ALL ACFT OWNED, CHARTERED OR OPERATED BY NATURAL OR LEGAL
PERSONS FROM THE REPUBLIC OF AUSTRIA OR BY OPERATORS HOLDING AOC
ISSUED BY THE REPUBLIC OF AUSTRIA, EXCEPT FOR HUMANITARIAN, SAR,
LEASED AIRCRAFT ONE-WAY RETURN FLIGHTS WITH PERMISSION OF THE
RELEVANT AUTHORITIES OF THE RUSSIAN FEDERATION, CASES OF EMERGENCY
LANDING OR EMERGENCY OVERFLIGHT, AS WELL AS IN CASES WHEN A SPECIAL
PERMISSION FOR END PART 1 OF 2
U1539/26 NOTAMR U1047/26 Q) UUWV/QOAXX/IV/BO/A/000/999/5535N03617E999 A) UUUU  PART 2 OF 2  B) 2611150500  C) 2702152359 EST  E) FLIGHT OPERATIONS IS GRANTED BY THE FEDERAL AIR
TRANSPORT AGENCY OR THE MINISTRY OF FOREGN AFFAIRS OF THE RUSSIAN
FEDERATION, AS APPROPRIATE. END PART 2 OF 2
